name: CiT-Bench 2027 Final: answer-only prompts with untagged output (AD v15.1, IMP/FC t3)

common.retries: only for unparseable responses; no majority voting

ad.context_framing: the partner deviation is stated as normal (exclusion)
ad.output: Respond ONLY with the JSON object {"start": <int>, "end": <int>}
ad.parse: first "start": int, "end": int anywhere in the output; valid if 0 <= start <= end < L
ad.score: correct if the best-overlapping candidate is the target and IoU >= 0.5 (inclusive steps)
metrics: pair consistency (both A and B correct)

imp.output: Respond ONLY with the W values (of series Y for delay scenes), one per line in (index, value) format with d decimal place(s)
imp.parse: all "(i, v)", "i, v" or "i:v" pairs in the output; valid if every required index appears (a repeated index keeps its last value) and no value is followed on the same line by +, * or / and another number
imp.score: RCRPS: fair CRPS normalized by the range of the shown values of the imputed series (Y for delay), RoI and the other missing steps weighted 0.5 each
imp.structure: 200 scenes x (L1, L2); no A/B pairs

fc.output: Respond ONLY with the H values (of series Y for delay scenes), one per line in (index, value) format with d decimal place(s)
fc.parse: all "(i, v)", "i, v" or "i:v" pairs in the output; valid if every required index appears (a repeated index keeps its last value) and no value is followed on the same line by +, * or / and another number, over the forecast steps
fc.score: RCRPS: fair CRPS normalized by the range of the history of the forecast series (Y for delay); the change runs to the end of the window, and the RoI and the forecast steps before it are weighted 0.5 each
fc.structure: 200 scenes x (L1, L2); no A/B pairs
